name: LibreSpeed
description: A speed test between your devices and the server.
compose:
services:
  librespeed:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/librespeed:latest
    container_name: librespeed
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
